HYDRAULIC UNIT
TSB Revision
ANTI-LOCK BRAKING SYSTEM (ABS)
35B-52
<<B>> HYDRAULIC UNIT REMOVAL
WARNING
The hydraulic unit is heavy. Use care when removing 
it.
CAUTION
• The hydraulic unit cannot be disassembled. Never 
loosen its nuts or bolts.
• Do not drop or shock the hydraulic unit.
• Do not turn the hydraulic unit upside down or lay it on 
its side.
INSTALLATION SERVICE POINT
>>A<< BRAKE TUBE INSTALLATION
Connect the tubes to the hydraulic unit as shown in the 
illustration.
1. To the proportioning valve (rear brake: LH)
2. To the proportioning valve (rear brake: RH)
3. From the master cylinder (primary)
4. From the master cylinder (secondary)
5. To the front brake (RH)
6. To the front brake (LH)
